# ATAS — How to import trades from ATAS into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/8490893-atas-how-to-import-trades-from-atas-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

With our straightforward guide, you can easily import your trades from ATAS into TradeZella. Follow these steps to ensure your trading data stays accurate and up-to-date.​

## Exporting trade data from ATAS into a file

- Start by logging into your ATAS desktop account. Once you're in, navigate to the Home Tab in the ATAS main window.

Start by logging into your ATAS desktop account. Once you're in, navigate to the Home Tab in the ATAS main window.

- Next, from the top menu, click on the Statistics Tab, and from the dropdown, click on the activate window button.

Next, from the top menu, click on the Statistics Tab, and from the dropdown, click on the activate window button.

- Now that you're on the Statistics tab, click the history button. Then, select the date range and the account from which you want to export trades. After selecting, click on the load button.

Now that you're on the Statistics tab, click the history button. Then, select the date range and the account from which you want to export trades. After selecting, click on the load button.

- After selecting the date range and account, go to the Executions tab. On the far right, click on the gear icon and select Export Statistics. Save the file to your desktop. Your trade data will be saved in an Excel (.xlsx) format file. Now, this file is ready to be imported into TradeZella.

After selecting the date range and account, go to the Executions tab. On the far right, click on the gear icon and select Export Statistics. Save the file to your desktop. Your trade data will be saved in an Excel (.xlsx) format file. Now, this file is ready to be imported into TradeZella.



## Uploading the exported file into TradeZella

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select ATAS as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select ATAS as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

## Common Errors

- Ensure your exported file aligns with TradeZella's required format. The file must be in .xlsx format, with headers in English:Account I Instrument I Time I Exchange ID I Direction I Price I Volume I Route I Commission

Ensure your exported file aligns with TradeZella's required format. The file must be in .xlsx format, with headers in English:

- Account I Instrument I Time I Exchange ID I Direction I Price I Volume I Route I Commission

Account I Instrument I Time I Exchange ID I Direction I Price I Volume I Route I Commission
